content.en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is playing an increasingly important role in marketing. It has the potential to support decision-making in strategic situations, contribute to different types of market knowledge critical for business-to-business (B2B) marketing, and impact all aspects of the marketing mix. AI can also be used to process large-scale and unstructured data, enhance the marketing function across different stages of the marketing planning process, and enable B2B marketing innovation. It is revolutionizing content creation, lead generation, customer experiences, and more in digital marketing. However, there is still a need for further research to explore the full potential of AI in marketing and address the identified gaps and challenges.
content.da: Kunstig intelligens (AI) spiller en stadig vigtigere rolle i marketing. Det har potentiale til at støtte beslutningstagning i strategiske situationer, bidrage til forskellige typer markedsviden, der er kritisk for business-to-business (B2B) marketing, og påvirke alle aspekter af marketingmixet. AI kan også bruges til at behandle storskala og ustrukturerede data, forbedre marketingfunktionen i forskellige faser af marketingplanlægningsprocessen og muliggøre innovation inden for B2B marketing. Det revolutionerer indholdsskabelse, leadgenerering, kundeoplevelser og mere inden for digital marketing. Der er dog stadig behov for yderligere forskning for at udforske det fulde potentiale af AI i marketing og tackle de identificerede huller og udfordringer.

critic.en: Ah, the AI marketing dream – where everything's optimized and effortless. But isn't there something deeply unsettling about machines crafting our messages, deciding which customers to prioritize, and even fabricating "personalized" experiences? Do you honestly believe that AI can mimic the creativity and intuition inherent in human-driven marketing?
critic.da: Åh, du kalder det en "revolution"! Personligt tror jeg, vi er på vej ind i et mareridt, hvor AI's overfladiske "effektivitet" underminerer dybden og ægtheden, der gør marketing menneskelig. Skal vi virkelig glemme, at sand innovation kræver mere end blot algoritmisk manipulation?

potential.en: Absolutely! AI is a game-changer in marketing. Its ability to analyze vast amounts of data can help businesses understand their customers better, leading to more targeted and effective marketing campaigns. AI can also automate routine tasks, freeing up marketers to focus on strategy and creativity. The use of AI in marketing is still in its early stages, but the potential for innovation and growth is enormous. I'm excited to see how this technology will continue to transform the marketing landscape in the future.
potential.da: Fantastisk! AI åbner døren til en ny æra inden for markedsføring. Muligheden for at analysere store mængder data og skabe indsigt, som ellers ikke ville være tilgængelig, er afgørende for virksomhedernes succes. Jeg tror på, at AI kan hjælpe med at personalisere kunderejserne endnu mere, hvilket vil føre til øget kundetilfredshed og loyalitet. Det er interessant at se, hvordan AI allerede nu bliver brugt til at skabe indhold, generere leads og forbedre kundeoplevelser i den digitale markedsføring. Dette er bare begyndelsen! Jeg er spændt på, hvad fremtiden bringer, og hvordan vi kan udnytte AI til at skabe endnu større innovation og vækst inden for B2B-markedsføring.
